description: A January 24 Burkina24 search result says ONATEL workers returned after nearly a month of strike, but the exact body timed out before retrieval. SYNATEL’s December 31 statement says a workplace crisis began November 17 and separately describes physical worker actions and police confrontation on December 29–30. The sources do not establish physical strike onset or a qualifying January public assembly; do not substitute the November 17 crisis date or infer a date from “nearly a month.”
open_questions: Did a mass physical action or public assembly occur at ONATEL in January, separate from the December 29–30 workplace confrontation?
When did the actual strike/work stoppage physically begin and end? The organizational crisis date is not enough.
Does the work stoppage meet the original Mass Mobilization event rule without a separate public assembly?
If revisiting the January 24 Burkina24 page, create a fresh exact-URL receipt and manually review before any retry.
